items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the mention of Joyce Gaino is made solely by the interviewer.

ctx.x: Danny Buff and Joyce Gaino both did that. Both of them. And Doc Ernest took his bass one day. Right? I love to see that. I like to see that, too. I will, too. He must have tied it on him. They do that in Philadelphia.
They have bands that have bass fiddles. It's a mama.
